title: What are dangerous online contacts?
body:
What are dangerous online contacts?

Dangerous contacts are when an unknown adult tries to befriend a child:
• "Hi! How are you? Let's be friends"
• "You're so smart! Let's meet?"
• "Don't tell your parents about our conversation"

⚠️ DANGEROUS! Adults shouldn't be friends with children online!

✅ ALADDIN notices suspicious conversations and immediately notifies parents.
